# Codex Documentation

> > Codex provides blockchain APIs for querying DEX trading data across Solana, Uniswap, Raydium, Orca, and other decentralized exchanges.

Codex is a comprehensive blockchain data API platform that enables developers to access real-time and historical trading pair information, liquidity data, and DEX analytics across multiple blockchain networks including Ethereum and Solana ecosystems.

## Key Topics

- Codex API
- UniswapV3 (UniV3)
- UniswapV2
- Raydium (RaydiumV4)
- Orca Whirlpool
- PumpAMM
- Solana DEXs
- Trading Pairs
- DEX Liquidity
- Token Pairs
- Query Endpoints
- Blockchain Data API

## API Reference

- [listPairsForToken](https://docs.codex.io/api-reference/queries/listpairsfortoken): API endpoint to query trading pairs for a given token across DEXs
